# HELP manta_spots_total Total spots published to the broadcast bus.
# TYPE manta_spots_total counter
manta_spots_total 1
# HELP manta_spots_by_band_total Spots published to the broadcast bus, by amateur band and spot type (sums to manta_spots_total).
# TYPE manta_spots_by_band_total counter
manta_spots_by_band_total{band="20m",type="cq"} 1
# HELP manta_spots_dropped_lagged_total Spots dropped because a slow client fell behind and was disconnected.
# TYPE manta_spots_dropped_lagged_total counter
manta_spots_dropped_lagged_total 0
# HELP manta_spots_suppressed_by_filter_total Spots suppressed by a client's own filter (e.g. set dx filter unique), not a lag disconnect.
# TYPE manta_spots_suppressed_by_filter_total counter
manta_spots_suppressed_by_filter_total 0
# HELP manta_spots_dropped_write_failed_total Spots dropped because a client's socket write timed out or failed before a lag/close error was observed.
# TYPE manta_spots_dropped_write_failed_total counter
manta_spots_dropped_write_failed_total 0
# HELP manta_spots_dropped_shutdown_total Spots abandoned because the daemon shut down while a client was still in its pre-login/handshake phase, before any socket write timed out or failed.
# TYPE manta_spots_dropped_shutdown_total counter
manta_spots_dropped_shutdown_total 0
# HELP manta_spots_replay_abandoned_total `sh/dx` history entries abandoned without being replayed, because the replay write failed or the daemon shut down mid-replay. Counted separately from live-delivery loss: these are re-sends of spots already counted in manta_spots_total.
# TYPE manta_spots_replay_abandoned_total counter
manta_spots_replay_abandoned_total 0
# HELP manta_spots_unresolved_geography_total Spots emitted with an UNKNOWN_DXCC/UNKNOWN_CONTINENT/UNKNOWN_CQ_ZONE sentinel on the dx or de side, because the callsign did not resolve against cty.dat, OR its entity carries no row in the vendored dxcc.tsv, OR it carries a /MM or /AM designator that places it outside any DXCC entity.
# TYPE manta_spots_unresolved_geography_total counter
manta_spots_unresolved_geography_total 0
